focus_area: AiJobCriteriaController (show/create) authorization + guards, routes singleton resource, JobAiJobCriteriaSerializer six-state payload

findings.title: Serializer issues 4 unmemoized latest-row queries per render (non-actionable observation)
findings.description: Each serialize runs the same two lookups twice with no memoization. `criteria` (line 7) and `extracted_at` (line 11) both call `object.latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria` (job.rb:692-694, one query each). `status` (line 15) calls `object.latest_ai_job_criteria` (job.rb:688-690) and `zero_criteria_failure` (line 19) calls `object.zero_criteria_extraction_failure?` which itself calls `latest_ai_job_criteria` again (job.rb:697) -- two more identical queries. So a single GET/POST render fires 4 DB queries for 2 distinct rows. This is `render_one` (a single Job, not a collection), so it is NOT an N+1 across rows, and the computed-delegation pattern is exactly what SPEC 5.3 prescribes (serializers.md 7). Negligible for a settings-tab fetch; noted only for completeness.
findings.recommendation: None required. If desired, memoize `latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria`/`latest_ai_job_criteria` on the Job instance, but this is not a defect and matches the surrounding pattern.
